name: Danel (Adir Yeoshua) Ltd
summary: Danel (Adir Yeoshua) Ltd provides human resources services in Israel. The company provides recruitment, placement, and employment services in the areas of finance, insurance, administration, senior management, high-tech, biotech, cleantech, as well as outsourcing project management services, technological employee employment services, and occupational and computerized diagnostic services; payroll services; and nursing and medical services to disabled seniors, ministry of defense beneficiaries, and others.
